profiles.name: Original turn planner with early potions
Scaling priority, medium HP price, early potions
Draw priority, medium HP price, early potions
Scaling priority, high HP price, delayed potions

lesson_bank: Use these empirically established room-level recipes on familiar deck/boss patterns. They are whole-policy choices; do not average them into a new policy. For an Ironclad fighting Kin Priest with a block/counterattack plan, retain the original turn planner and use potions early. For an Ironclad against Ceremonial Beast with Feel No Pain, Armaments and Flame Barrier, prioritize scaling with medium HP-loss price (1.5) and early potions. For a Regent against Kin with Glow/Photon Cut, star generation and Astral Pulse, prioritize draw with medium HP-loss price (1.5) and early potions. For a Necrobinder against Kin with No Escape, summon support and Duplicator/Energy potions, prioritize scaling with high HP-loss price (3.0) and delay potions to turn 5. These recipes were tested together as complete battle policies; individual-card causality and new-seed generalization are unproven.
scope: E096 familiar-state recipe transfer; not held-out strategy generalization
